game_title: Sentinel Loop – Mine Cart Tunnel Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Sentinel Loop: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word. Each round, shadow wraiths strike the mine cart, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the queue_length value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the mine cart from shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel: keep the queue_length meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: queue_length drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Sentinel Loop
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_length changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while queue_length > 0.
